verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the original's single row of apothecary illustrations is broken up: the bottle and the sachet float on their own down a diagonal through empty space, the mortar group and the right-hand jar are pushed into the bottom corners, and the shapes at the bottom edge look cramped and partly cut off. A's label sits almost against the top edge of the canvas, leaving an uneven top margin. B moves the label down a little, which gives it slightly better breathing room, but it has the same scattered middle section.
